quarterly_data.quarter: Tocalo results presentation: Financial Results Presentation (1Q FY2026) (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Tocalo 1Q FY2026 (April-June 2026): net sales 16,658 million JPY (+9.9%), a record quarter; Semicon & FPD thermal-spray sales rose 29.9% to a quarterly record 8,148 million JPY (48.9% of sales), while overseas subsidiaries fell 3.2% on inventory adjustments by certain customers. Ordinary profit 4,024 million JPY (-0.7%) on higher labor costs, depreciation and the overseas inventory adjustments.
